entities.name: Message authentication code
entities.description: Contains the integrity protection information for the message. It is included in security protected NAS messages when a valid EPS security context exists and security functions are started.

entities.name: Security protected NAS message
entities.description: A NAS message that includes integrity protection through the MAC IE when security conditions are met.

entities.name: EPS security context
entities.description: A valid EPS security context must exist for the MAC IE to be included in security protected NAS messages.

entities.name: Security functions started
entities.description: Security functions must be started for the MAC IE to be included in security protected NAS messages.

relations.description: The security protected NAS message contains the MAC IE for integrity protection.
Inclusion of MAC IE is guarded by the condition that a valid EPS security context exists.
Inclusion of MAC IE is guarded by the condition that security functions are started.
The MAC IE provides integrity protection for the security protected NAS message.
